هذا المستند يوضح 
خطوات الفحص 
السنوى 
الخاص 
بنظام 
مقاومة الحريق والتبريد على تنكات 
السولار

- النظام عبارة عن 
تنك من مادة الفوم الرغوي سعة 
20,\000 
لتر ، يخرج منه مسارات الفوم إلى تنكات السولار 1 ، 2 عن طريق الطلمبة المركبة بعد 
تنك الفوم كما يتم تبريد التنكات بواسطة رشاشات مياه موزعة على كل تنك .

أعد المسودة 
الأولية المهندس / أحمد محمد المهتدى قمرة وإختبرها المهندس / 
عبد المجيد الحناوى 
وراجعها

المهندس / السعيد 
شعبان عبد القادر 
ووافق عليها السيد 
المهندس / مجدي عقبة مدير عام صيانة الغلايات 
واعتمدها السيد 
المهندس / أحمد عبد المجيد صوان رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء النوبارية 
.

راجعها 
السيد الكيميائي/ 
إبراهيم يوسف يوسف مفتش السلامة والصحة المهنية بقطاع التفتيش ووافق 
على المستند المهندس / سمير عبد الجليل مدير عام التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة وسط 
الدلتا لإنتاج الكهرباء ومنسق الشركة لنظام معلومات إجراءات الصيانة ووثق من السيد 
المهندس / 
محمد نجيب عبد الحي 
رئيس قطاع التفتيش 
ومراقبة الجودة بشركة وسط الدلتا لإنتاج الكهرباء 
.

rows:
إصدار 
 أمر شغل معتمد من الجهة المختصة ويجب أن يحمل القائمون بأعمال الصيانة كارت 
 فئة السلامة والصحة المهنية .

تسوير 
 المكان لتحديد منطقة العمل وكذلك وضع علامات التحذير .

اتباع 
 إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية للأفراد والمعدات وإرتداء مهمات الوقاية 
 الشخصية ( خوذة أمان،حذاء 
 أمان، أفرول، جوانتى 
 .....)
شنطة العدة كاملة
سوائل تنظيف

تأكد من أن نظام الإطفاء 
 بالخدمة.

مراجعة جميع 
 الإجراءات الرئيسية بالنظام.

تأكد من أن 
 المكان مهيأ لأداء التجربة وتفريغ المياه .

يتم تحديد منطقة العمل وتسويرها ووضع العلامات التحذيرية 
 المناسبة .
تأكد أن العدادات بحالة جيدة وتقرا بطريقة صحيحة .
تأكد من منسوب تانك الرغوي مناسب لأداء التجربة .
تأكد أن جميع البلوف علي خط الفوم مفتوحة وبحالة جيدة .
تأكد أن ضغط المياه قبل بلف الديلوج مناسب لأداء التجربة .

تأكد من تحويل مسار مياه الإطفاء بالمادة الرغوية إلي خارج 
 التنك عن طريق فتح اقرب فلانشة من ناحية التنك.

يتم اختبار المحس الحراري عن طريق رفع درجة حرارته حتيcه
 108 والتأكد من أن النظام يعمل بطريقة آلية
يتم اختبار بدء التشغيل اليدوي للنظام .

تأكد 
 من سماع صوت إنذار الحريق على التانك وتسجيل الوقت حتى سماع 
 صوت الإنذار على لوحة مراقبة نظام الحريق .
التأكد من أن جميع الإنذارات تعمل بطريقة صحيحة .
التأكد أن بلف الديلوج يفتح بطريقة صحيحة .
التأكد من خروج مياه التبريد على جسم التنك .
التأكد أن جميع الرشاشات سليمة وتعمل بصورة جيدة .
التأكد أن جميع الرشاشات موجهه بطريقة صحيحة لتبريد جسم التنك.
التأكد من تشغيل نظام الإطفاء بالرغوي .
التأكد من نسبة خلط الفوم مع المياه ( في حدود 3 % ) .

التأكد من ضغط المياه أثناء الاختبار وانه لا يصل إلي الحد 
 الادني للتشغيل( 10 بار ).

تأكد أن إنذار إرسال المياه إلي التنك يعمل علي لوحة الحريق
 ACP-012
يتم غلق بلف المياه الرئيسي ( قبل بلف الديلوج ) .
التأكد أن بلف التصفية الرئيسي يعمل
التأكد أن بلف التصفية المساعد يعمل .

التأكد أن إنذار خروج المياه التنك اختفي علي لوحة الحريق
 ACP-012

إرجاع 
 زراع التشغيل اليدوي للنظام.

يتم إعادة صمام بلف الديلوج إلي وضعة قبل تشغيل النظام ( 
 الوضع مغلق ) .

يتم 
 فتح بلف المياه الرئيسي قبل ( بلف الديلوج ) .
التأكد من غلق بلف الديلوج والتأكد من ضغط المياه قبل البلف
يتم إرجاع مسار نظام الإطفاء بالرغوي إلي داخل التانك .
مراجعة منسوب تانك الرغوي .

ملاحظة 
 جميع الأجزاء الرئيسية للنظام والتأكد أنها بحالة جيده .

التأكد 
 أن جميع العدادات تعمل بصورة جيدة .

التأكد أن لوحة مراقبة نظام الإطفاء تعمل بحالة جيدة ورفع جميع 
 الإنذارات علي اللوحة .

رفع 
 التسوير واللوحات التحذيرية من مكان العمل .
التأكد أن النظام في الخدمة .

Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: FS-064-r0a
Equipment: Automatic fire extinguishing and cooling system on the diesel tanks, Mueller (USA)
Issued to: Middle Delta Electricity Production Company
Document status: Approved
Date of document approval: 8April 2009
Procedure: Annual periodic inspection (Y1)
Date of next review: April 2014

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps for the annual inspection of the fire-fighting and cooling system on the diesel tanks.

The system consists of a foam concentrate tank of 20,000 litres capacity, from which the foam lines run to diesel tanks 1 and 2 through the pump installed after the foam tank; the tanks are also cooled by water sprinklers distributed over each tank.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Magid El-Henawy, and reviewed by
Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, approved by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Magid Sawan, Head of Nubaria Power Station Sector.

It was reviewed by Chemist Ibrahim Youssef Youssef, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection Sector, and the document was approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's coordinator for the Maintenance Procedures Information System, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.

rows: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance must hold an Occupational Safety and Health category card.
Fence off the place to define the work area and put up warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves, ...).
Complete tool bag
Cleaning fluids
Make sure the fire extinguishing system is in service.
Check all the main procedures of the system.
Make sure the place is prepared for carrying out the test and draining the water.
Define the work area, fence it off and put up the appropriate warning signs.
Make sure the gauges are in good condition and read correctly.
Make sure the foam tank level is suitable for carrying out the test.
Make sure all the valves on the foam line are open and in good condition.
Make sure the water pressure before the deluge valve is suitable for carrying out the test.
Make sure the fire extinguishing water path with the foam agent is diverted outside the tank by opening the nearest flange on the tank side.
The heat sensor is tested by raising its temperature to 108 °C and making sure the system operates automatically
The manual start of the system is tested.
Make sure the fire alarm sound is heard on the tank and record the time until the alarm sound is heard on the fire system monitoring panel.
Make sure all the alarms are working correctly.
Make sure the deluge valve opens correctly.
Make sure the cooling water comes out onto the tank body.
Make sure all the sprinklers are sound and working well.
Make sure all the sprinklers are directed correctly to cool the tank body.
Make sure the foam fire extinguishing system is operating.
Make sure the foam-to-water mixing ratio is (within 3%).
Make sure the water pressure during the test does not fall to the minimum operating limit (10 bar).
Make sure the alarm for sending water to the tank is working on the ACP-012 fire panel
Close the main water valve (before the deluge valve).
Make sure the main drain valve is working
Make sure the auxiliary drain valve is working.
Make sure the alarm for water leaving the tank has disappeared on the ACP-012 fire panel
Return the manual operating lever of the system.
Return the deluge valve to its position before the system was operated (closed position).
Open the main water valve before (the deluge valve).
Make sure the deluge valve is closed and check the water pressure before the valve
Return the foam fire extinguishing system path to inside the tank.
Check the foam tank level.
Observe all the main parts of the system and make sure they are in good condition.
Make sure all the gauges are working well.
Make sure the fire extinguishing system monitoring panel is working well and clear all the alarms on the panel.
Remove the fencing and warning signs from the work area.
Make sure the system is in service.

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Transformer Stations | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: FS-064-r0a | Equipment: Automatic fire extinguishing and cooling system on the diesel tanks, Mueller (USA)
Issued to: Middle Delta Electricity Production Company
Document status: Approved
Date of document approval: 8April 2009 | Procedure: Annual periodic inspection (Y1)
Date of next review: April 2014
Introduction
This document sets out the steps for the annual inspection of the fire-fighting and cooling system on the diesel tanks.
The system consists of a foam concentrate tank of 20,000 litres capacity, from which the foam lines run to diesel tanks 1 and 2 through the pump installed after the foam tank; the tanks are also cooled by water sprinklers distributed over each tank.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Magid El-Henawy, and reviewed by
Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, approved by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Magid Sawan, Head of Nubaria Power Station Sector.
It was reviewed by Chemist Ibrahim Youssef Youssef, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection Sector, and the document was approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's coordinator for the Maintenance Procedures Information System, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance must hold an Occupational Safety and Health category card. | 
Fence off the place to define the work area and put up warning signs. | 
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves, ...). | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Complete tool bag | 
Cleaning fluids | 
Procedure to be Carried Out
First: Before the Test Starts
Make sure the fire extinguishing system is in service. | 
Check all the main procedures of the system. | 2.
Make sure the place is prepared for carrying out the test and draining the water. | 3.
Define the work area, fence it off and put up the appropriate warning signs. | 4.
Make sure the gauges are in good condition and read correctly. | 5.
Make sure the foam tank level is suitable for carrying out the test. | 6.
Make sure all the valves on the foam line are open and in good condition. | 7.
Make sure the water pressure before the deluge valve is suitable for carrying out the test. | 8.
Make sure the fire extinguishing water path with the foam agent is diverted outside the tank by opening the nearest flange on the tank side. | 9.
Second: Test Steps
The heat sensor is tested by raising its temperature to 108 °C and making sure the system operates automatically | 1.
The manual start of the system is tested. | 2.
Make sure the fire alarm sound is heard on the tank and record the time until the alarm sound is heard on the fire system monitoring panel. | 3.
Make sure all the alarms are working correctly. | 4.
Make sure the deluge valve opens correctly. | 5.
Make sure the cooling water comes out onto the tank body. | 6.
Make sure all the sprinklers are sound and working well. | 7.
Make sure all the sprinklers are directed correctly to cool the tank body. | 8.
Make sure the foam fire extinguishing system is operating. | 9.
Make sure the foam-to-water mixing ratio is (within 3%). | 10.
Make sure the water pressure during the test does not fall to the minimum operating limit (10 bar). | 11.
Make sure the alarm for sending water to the tank is working on the ACP-012 fire panel | 12.
Close the main water valve (before the deluge valve). | 13.
Make sure the main drain valve is working | 14.
Make sure the auxiliary drain valve is working. | 15
Make sure the alarm for water leaving the tank has disappeared on the ACP-012 fire panel | 16
After the Test
Return the manual operating lever of the system. | 1.
Return the deluge valve to its position before the system was operated (closed position). | 2.
Open the main water valve before (the deluge valve). | 3.
Make sure the deluge valve is closed and check the water pressure before the valve | 4.
Return the foam fire extinguishing system path to inside the tank. | 5.
Check the foam tank level. | 6.
Observe all the main parts of the system and make sure they are in good condition. | 7.
Make sure all the gauges are working well. | 8.
Make sure the fire extinguishing system monitoring panel is working well and clear all the alarms on the panel. | 9.
Remove the fencing and warning signs from the work area. | 10.
Make sure the system is in service. | 11.
